name: normandy-house-landlords
description: Normandy House Landlords: what Normandy House, Inc. reports to the IRS, and what its residents sign

scripts.build: npm run check && npm run cleanup && npx parcel build --public-url ./ && cp -r src/static/. dist/
scripts.push-gh: npm run build && gh-pages --dist dist --branch gh-pages --cname www.normandyhouselandlords.org --nojekyll --message "Deploy $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"

author: Jason Sherrick
